say:1:1130125001:1.text: Every Mauler in the Uru Settlement does this when they collect water.
say:1:1130125001:1.source_cn: 每个乌尔聚落的蛮血在取水时，都会这么做。

say:2:1130125002:1.text: "The Uru Settlement must never forget the great creator of the oasis," I remember Pops saying this all the time.
say:2:1130125002:1.source_cn: “乌尔聚落不会忘记创造出绿洲的恩人”，我记得老爹当时是...

say:3:1130125003:1.text: Merlin's name will be kept alive for as long as the Uru Settlement exists.
say:3:1130125003:1.source_cn: 只要乌尔聚落不消失，梅林的名讳将被乌尔聚落一直传颂下去。
say:3:1130125003:1.male: Merlin's name will be kept alive for as long as the Uru Settlement exists.
say:3:1130125003:1.female: Merlin's name will be kept alive for as long as the Uru Settlement exists.
